versionImpact.rationale: This change additively publishes KFD-5 and draft KFD-6 decisions, schemas, usage routes, and self-proof evidence while preserving existing registry shape, package paths, and schemaVersion 1 compatibility.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: KFD documents are append-only content coordinates; current documentation changes add KFD-5 as the active grounded primitive-discovery procedure and KFD-6 as a draft autonomous-discovery procedure, while preserving existing decision numbers and registry shape.
registry.json keeps schemaVersion 1 and the existing entry shape, including number, id, slug, title, kind, status, path, and url; slug and path values are stable number coordinates.

standards.json and schemas/ add KFD-5 primitive-discovery and draft KFD-6 autonomous-discovery-loop interfaces, concept metadata, and document SHA-256 bindings while preserving existing KFD interfaces and metadata schemaVersion 1.

The npm package additively publishes KFD-5 and KFD-6 decisions, usage notes, schemas, standards metadata, site routes, and self-proof evidence through existing decisions/, docs/, schemas/, standards.json, site/, scripts/, and .buildchain/ package surfaces.

KFD now uses Buildchain v2 floating workflow refs with a consumer-owned buildchain.contract-lock.json, so Buildchain runtime contract drift is checked before heavy build or promotion work while retaining floating-ref upgrade flow.

site/kfd-site.json now projects KFD-5 and KFD-6 into the sequential practice-guideline model and current decision routes while preserving the KFD-1/2/3 foundation triad as the first-screen closed foundation.
site/kfd-site.json now exposes decisionPages.usagePages, mapping each authoritative KFD decision page to its docs/KFD-N-usage.md child page and stable /N/usage route.
KFD now declares its own participant-facing collaboration interface and ships pre-build plus artifact-side KFD-3 witnesses so Buildchain can audit interface closure in the release passport.
KFD-3 collaboration interfaces now declare explicit valueEvidence that binds participant-facing value claims to fact artifacts, evidence artifacts, KFD-2 trust assessments, and residual-risk state.
KFD now ships an explicit machine-bound public KFD-2 release trust claim and passes it into Buildchain release passport generation.
KFD-2 generic trust claims and assessment now include package-level KFD-5 and KFD-6 claims, explicitly downgrading KFD-6 because the draft autonomous capability lacks adopter evidence.

Decision documents now use stable numbered paths under decisions/KFD-N.md, while usage documentation uses docs/KFD-N-usage.md to distinguish authoritative decision text from consumer implementation notes.
KFD now declares its package version through an anchored/manual release manifest so package version state is an explicit release fact rather than an auto-derived Buildchain side effect.

The KFD to site-libkungfu-dev propagation graph now targets the downstream site's actual main branch and documents the exact KFD package surfaces consumed by kfd.libkungfu.dev, without changing the release propagation graph contract.
KFD-1 now defines breaking, additive, none, and unclassifiable as the generic compatibility-impact core, with release versioning as one projection rather than the only interpretation.
standards.json now publishes the KFD package surface register as the KFD-1 fact source, and the KFD-1 witness projects each registered surface class and impact projection from that fact source.

KFD-1 now publishes a machine-readable schema for canonical reader URLs, latest aliases, immutable version artifact URLs, artifact digests, source coordinates, lineage, site consumption, and archive policies that prevent same-version digest drift or destructive deletion of immutable publication prefixes.
